items.markdown:
![Chicken Massaman Curry Recipe](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280251-1672-0139-0000-611caf51ce2f:4)
Massaman curry is `a rich, mild, and flavorful Thai curry that blends traditional Thai aromatics with warm Indian and Persian spices like cinnamon, cardamom, and cloves` . It is typically made with coconut milk, potatoes, peanuts, and meat.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massaman_curry) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massaman_curry)[[2]](https://thai-foodie.com/thaifood/massaman-curry-paste-recipe/)

Key Ingredients and Flavor Profile

- **The Paste:** Combines Thai staples (lemongrass, galangal, garlic) with toasted dry spices (cumin, nutmeg, cinnamon, cloves, cardamom).
- **The Base:** Thick coconut milk or cream gives it a velvety, rich texture.
- **Add-ins:** Waxy potatoes, onions, and whole or crushed peanuts.
- **Flavor Balance:** Mildly spicy with a signature tang from tamarind paste and sweetness from palm sugar.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massaman_curry) [[1]](https://www.theguardian.com/food/2026/feb/15/perfect-massaman-recipe-felicity-cloake)[[2]](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/beef-massaman-curry)[[3]](https://carlsbadcravings.com/massaman-curry/)

Origins and Culture

- **Fusion Roots:** Brought to Thailand via southern trade routes by Persian and Malay Muslims, making it a staple of Muslim-Thai cuisine.
- **Meat Choices:** Commonly prepared with chicken, beef, or lamb, but traditionally excludes pork.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/massaman-curry/) [[1]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/massaman-curry/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-B7Qfwh9vGQ&t=50)[[3]](https://alwaysusebutter.com/massaman-chicken-curry/)

If you'd like, let me know if you want:

- An **easy home recipe** using store-bought paste
- Instructions on **how to make the paste from scratch**

expanded_element.description: The mildest of the trio, Thai Massaman curry is a comforting choice for those new to Thai cuisine or looking for something less spicy.
